description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2530016466243 LINING MATERIAL,FRI: Line 0001 Qty 140 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0042 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
